description: Land Acquisition - Kandegedara, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels (including lot numbers, descriptions, extents, and claimant information) for public purposes. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in Type 4 (Land Gazettes) and does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
